description: This file declares exported API functions for the CCSP CWMP WMP Session object, including creation, removal, object enrollment, and initialization functions. It serves as an interface definition for other components to interact with the CWMP protocol implementation.

methods.name: CcspCwmpCreateWmpSession
methods.description: Creates a new WMP Session object with the specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: CcspCwmpsoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new CWMP session object with the specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: CcspCwmpsoRemove
methods.description: Removes and deallocates the specified CWMP session object.

methods.name: CcspCwmpsoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects within the CWMP session object to prepare for operation.

methods.name: CcspCwmpsoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the CWMP session object, performing setup tasks.
